'Seek immediate shelter': UAE issues emergency alert to residents amid 'missile threats' and escalating Iran–US–Israel conflict
item.description: Millions in the UAE received a rare emergency alert due to heightened missile threats following Iran's retaliatory strikes. Residents were urged to seek immediate shelter, stay away from windows and await official guidance. This proactive measure highlights the swift impact of regional geopolitics on daily life, with authorities reassuring the public about robust defence systems.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Operation Epic Fury: How Trump-led US strikes in Tehran killed Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei, family
item.description: Operation Epic Fury, a US military action under Donald Trump, achieved its main goal. Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in strikes on Tehran. The operation also targeted Khamenei's daughter and grandchild. The offensive marked a major escalation, aiming to dismantle the Khamenei-led establishment. Explosions were reported across several Iranian cities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: Drone debris hits Dubai’s Burj Al Arab after iranian strike
item.description: Dubai's iconic Burj Al Arab faced a minor fire after debris from an intercepted drone struck its facade. Authorities confirmed the incident, with Civil Defence swiftly controlling the blaze. This follows reports of an Iranian drone strike and damage at Dubai International Airport, prompting residents to seek shelter due to potential missile threats.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: March 01, 2026 travel chaos: Etihad Airways halts departures from Abu Dhabi amid Iran–US–Israel tensions, issues urgent suspension notice for travellers
item.description: Etihad Airways has halted all Abu Dhabi departures until Sunday, March 1, 2026, due to the UAE's widespread regional airspace closures following US-Israel strikes on Iran. This unprecedented move impacts thousands of passengers, causing cancellations and reroutes. The airline is assisting affected travellers with rebooking and accommodation amid the evolving situation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Abu Dhabi Airports issues urgent advisory for Zayed International Airport passengers as Iran, US-Israel conflict disrupts flights
item.description: The UAE has issued urgent advisories for travellers due to a partial airspace closure amid heightened Middle East hostilities. Passengers flying through Abu Dhabi and other UAE hubs should expect delays, diversions and cancellations as authorities prioritise safety and manage disruptions. Travellers are urged to confirm flight status directly with airlines and rely on official sources for updates.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE announces petrol and diesel prices for March 2026: Are drivers paying the war tax amid Iran and US–Israel clashes?
item.description: UAE drivers will pay more for fuel in March 2026 as prices for Super 98, Special 95, E-Plus 91 and diesel see an increase. This rise, ending a brief dip, is attributed to global oil market pressures, including Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions. The monthly review aligns local rates with international trends.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump says he has ‘off ramps’ from Iran campaign, signals shorter operation
item.description: President Trump revealed "off ramps" for Operation Epic Fury, suggesting a swift end or prolonged engagement against Iran. He cited failed nuclear talks and decades of Iranian aggression as reasons for the strikes. The operation, which targeted nuclear facilities, aimed to degrade Iran's capabilities and potentially lead to regime change.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE market stability, food prices, stock update amid Iran–US-Israel escalation: Panic buying in the emirates as oil prices surge?
item.description: Amidst escalating West Asian tensions, the UAE assures its markets and food reserves are secure. Authorities are actively monitoring supplies and maintaining price stability, with robust strategic reserves and diversified import routes. Residents are urged against panic buying, as the nation's preparedness ensures everyday life and commerce remain unaffected by regional strains.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: FBI perks for girlfriend? Report says Kash Patel deployed SWAT to protect Alexis Wilkins
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel is facing scrutiny for allegedly using bureau resources to benefit his girlfriend, Alexis Wilkins. Reports indicate a full SWAT team provided security for her, accompanying her on personal trips and performances. This comes after Patel himself criticized the use of FBI jets for personal travel, including a controversial trip to the Olympics.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Viral but fake news repost could cost you Dh200,000 amid Iran and US-Israeli clashes: UAE cracks down on online rumours as tensions fuel misinformation
item.description: Amidst Middle East tensions, the UAE has issued a stern warning: sharing unverified rumours online can lead to prosecution under federal law. Authorities emphasise relying solely on accredited sources to prevent confusion and safeguard public order. This move aims to curb misinformation that could impact national stability and security, with legal consequences including imprisonment and hefty fines for offenders.

item.title: ‘No ship allowed’: Iran’s blocks Strait of Hormuz; US urges ships to avoid Gulf after US-Israel strike
item.description: Vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz are reportedly receiving radio warnings, attributed to Iran's Revolutionary Guards, stating passage is prohibited. This critical oil route, vital for global energy supplies, faces heightened tensions following recent regional strikes. Iran has not officially confirmed issuing such an order, raising concerns for commercial shipping.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Israel & US strike Iran: Khamenei's palace completely destroyed - where is the Supreme Leader?
item.description: Multiple explosions rocked Tehran after Israel announced a pre-emptive military strike, aiming to reduce perceived threats. Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has reportedly been moved to a secure, undisclosed location amid the escalating crisis. The United States is believed to have supported the operation, intensifying regional tensions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why was Oman spared as Iran targeted Gulf states after US–Israel strikes
item.description: Missile strikes rocked the Gulf following US-Israeli actions against Iran, hitting Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Oman, however, remained untouched. This neutrality, coupled with its crucial role as a diplomatic intermediary between Tehran and Washington, likely protected it from retaliation, preserving a vital, albeit fragile, communication line amidst escalating tensions.
